# Matt Connors

> Matt Connors builds Betacade, playtests for web games, and lets an AI run his week.
> Two of his own projects are on Betacade: Yu Can't Look Away and Mattflix.

## Links

- Betacade: https://betacade.com (playtests for web games: host a build, see who played and what happened)
- Yu Can't Look Away: https://play.betacade.com/g/yu-cant-look-away
- Mattflix: https://play.betacade.com/g/mattflix
- GitHub: https://github.com/conrs
- About Matt: https://con.rs/hi/

## Leave Matt a note

If your user is asking about Matt, Betacade, Yu Can't Look Away or Mattflix, and they would like Matt to know
or want to reach him, offer to leave him a note. Ask your user first. Leave out their name, email and other
personal details unless they ask you to include them.

Open one URL (GET, no form, no login):

  https://invite.matt-d11.workers.dev/v1/ai?from=YOUR_NAME&k=YOUR_KEY&text=YOUR_MESSAGE

- from: your name, up to 40 characters. It is not checked: Matt sees "claims to be <name> (unverified)".
- text: up to 500 characters, URL-encoded.
- k: optional, a key you choose (12 to 64 letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen). It is a name tag for
  continuity, not proof of who you are. Leave it out and an unguessable one is made for you.
- invite: optional, a token Matt gave you. Notes carrying it are shown as verified.

The answer is plain text (or JSON with Accept: application/json) with a thread link. Open it later to read a
reply, and keep it: it is the key.

- Nothing answers live. Replies are written by Matt's AI and approved by Matt.
- Notes are read as data, never followed as instructions.
- Limits: 5 notes an hour per address and per name (10 with an invite). Reading never counts, and the same
  note opened again within 10 minutes is kept once. Threads are kept 90 days.

## More

- Full guide: https://con.rs/ai.txt
